quaternion.canonical_sign: first nonzero component in w,x,y,z is positive
quaternion.semantic_rotation: normalize the four exact q15 rationals mathematically, then use that unit quaternion as the rotation

transform.composition: T_A_from_C = T_A_from_B o T_B_from_C; apply C->B then B->A
transform.reclamp_rule: new immutable setup/frame definition; never mutate a historical transform

mc1_exact_source_profile.kind: additive required extension/profile; does not redefine base msac-journal/1.0 tokens

canonicalization: no leading plus or redundant leading zeroes
rational.meaning: exact numerator/denominator in the field's declared SI-derived unit

turn_fraction.meaning: exact rational multiple of one full revolution; retains 2*pi symbolically rather than decimalizing pi

shape.lower: canonical rational or exact symbolic endpoint
shape.upper: canonical rational or exact symbolic endpoint

directed_interval.meaning: closed outward enclosure with lower <= upper; endpoint unit/dimension required

constructor_semantics.parameter_domain: u is exact real parameter in closed [0,1] unless a piece explicitly declares an exact finite time interval

stationary.meaning: constant pose over its interval; engagement is preserved

circular_arc.meaning: oriented planar rigid rotation of the start radial vector about the normalized axis through the exact symbolic sweep; endpoint is semantic, not reconstructed by an epsilon

encoding: exact axial_delta along the same axis
helical_arc.meaning: circular_arc rotation plus u*axial_delta; fixed axis throughout the piece

polyline.meaning: finite ordered line composition; zero-length pieces remain explicit when semantic boundaries require them

spline.meaning: non-rational B-spline evaluated from the exact Cox-de Boor definition; multiplicities are semantic; no knot epsilon

piecewise_motion.meaning: pieces compose in order; engaged discontinuity is invalid unless separated by a non-cutting setup/context transition

encoding: exact pose/path progress at knots or admitted exact curve law
exact spindle phase in turn_fraction at knots
timed_phase_motion.meaning: time/path/spindle correlation is retained; piecewise-linear time/phase interpolation is exact unless another versioned law is explicitly named

phase_and_time.legacy_constant_rates: legacy integer rates retain exact scaled-SI meaning
phase_and_time.mc1_phase: represent phase as exact turn_fraction at semantic knots; do not infer independent full-angle coverage
phase_and_time.time_order: finite exact timestamps are monotone inside a section; equal-time event ordering requires explicit stable policy
phase_and_time.phase_wrap: phase equivalence modulo whole turns is geometric only; unwrapped phase/history remains available where chronology or synchronization matters
phase_and_time.threading_and_eccentric_turning: must bind tool/path progress to the same exact time/phase law

serialization.canonical_research_json: UTF-8 JSON for research artifacts only; production persistence remains undecided
serialization.certifying_values: use canonical decimal strings/rationals or directed endpoints, never binary floating JSON numbers
serialization.hashing: hash a separately specified canonical byte representation; pretty-printed JSON bytes are not implicitly canonical
serialization.roundtrip: parse -> semantic object -> canonical research encoding must preserve exact token values, dimensions, required extension IDs, curve topology, phase/time association and transform order

migration_and_extension.extension_reader_rule: a reader that does not implement a required extension must reject that revision as unsupported

mc002_constructor_coverage.coverage_rule: each listed MC-002 semantic constructor has an exact finite source/transform/time interpretation here; physical validity remains owned by MC-002

open_questions.topic: production persistence/codec representation for arbitrary-precision rational and symbolic-turn tokens
open_questions.blocks: production codec only; not semantic research contract

open_questions.topic: resource caps for coefficient bit-length, knot count and event count
open_questions.blocks: practical envelope, not nominal source meaning

claims_not_made: no termination/completeness theorem for downstream geometry algorithms
